note: Worked example for filed.fyi (#250, #255). Globs are relative to content/; copy to the filed repo root as knap-policy.json, or pass --policy. Bands and floors were set from `knap-mcp audit` over filed@ce44821f (density/3): verse maxima sit just above today's maxima, prose floors ~2 points under today's means. Genre beats score: verse is never pushed toward block apparatus and never voice-rewritten line by line.

collections.name: haikus
collections.note: Three lines. A low score is correct. Block apparatus is damage; links and lists neither earn nor cost.

collections.name: limericks
collections.note: Five-line stanzas; existing emphasis is the author's. Verse lines are never voice-eligible.

collections.name: aphorisms
collections.note: One-paragraph sayings. No block pushes; a mild inline pass over the prose paragraphs is allowed.

collections.name: mascots
collections.note: Upgrade target. Under 25 is the upgrade queue; caps stop a runaway ratchet.

collections.name: reference
collections.note: Upgrade target. The ~33-word stubs land in the upgrade queue, which is where they belong.

collections.name: changelog
collections.note: Archival residue: watched for regression and over-upgrade, never queued for upgrade.

collections.name: releases
collections.note: Archival residue, as changelog. Too few records for a floor.

collections.name: posts
collections.note: Editorial prose. Too few records for a floor or an upgrade queue yet.

collections.name: indexes
collections.note: Trunk index pages (haikus.md, ...) and index.md: listings, not records. Judged by nothing, voiced by nothing.
